title: Sale of land court maps.
bodyText: The department of accounting and general services may sell land court maps, for a reasonable fee as established by rules adopted under chapter 91.
bodyHtml: [§501-219]  Sale of land court maps.  The department of accounting and general services may sell land court maps, for a reasonable fee as established by rules adopted under chapter 91. [L 1981, c 146, §1]
